commands.name: init
commands.summary: Initialize an empty policy for typed authoring

commands.name: grant add
commands.summary: Append a grant to the policy
commands.usage: grant add --src SRC --dst DST --ip PROTO:PORT [--src-posture posture:NAME] [--comment TEXT]

commands.name: grant remove
commands.summary: Remove a grant by zero-based index

commands.name: group add
commands.summary: Add login or autogroup members to a group; idempotent and merges into an existing group
commands.usage: group add --name group:NAME --member LOGIN [--member LOGIN ...] [--comment TEXT]

commands.name: group remove
commands.summary: Remove a group definition; referenced groups require --force

commands.name: ipset add
commands.summary: Add members to an ipset (CIDR, address, range, host:, ipset:, or add/remove operations); a remove requires every member to be an explicit operation; idempotent and merges into an existing ipset
commands.usage: ipset add --name ipset:NAME (--member MEMBER | --cidr CIDR) [--member MEMBER ...] [--cidr CIDR ...] [--comment TEXT]

commands.name: ipset remove
commands.summary: Remove an ipset definition; referenced ipsets require --force

commands.name: ssh add
commands.summary: Add an SSH rule; selector order is ignored, duplicate rules are a no-op, and check without a period differs from check with one
commands.usage: ssh add --action accept|check --src SRC --dst DST --user USER [--check-period DURATION|always] [--recorder DST] [--enforce-recorder] [--comment TEXT]

commands.name: ssh remove
commands.summary: Remove an SSH rule by semantic identity or zero-based index; check without a period differs from check with one
commands.usage: ssh remove (--index N | --action accept|check --src SRC --dst DST --user USER [--check-period DURATION|always] [--recorder DST] [--enforce-recorder])

commands.name: nodeattr add
commands.summary: Add attributes or IP pools to a target set; target order is ignored and matching entries are merged
commands.usage: nodeattr add --target SELECTOR [--target SELECTOR ...] (--attr NAME [--attr NAME ...] | --ip-pool CIDR [--ip-pool CIDR ...]) [--comment TEXT] [--overwrite-comment]

commands.name: nodeattr remove
commands.summary: Remove attributes or IP pools from every matching target entry, pruning entries left empty, or remove one by index
commands.usage: nodeattr remove (--index N | --target SELECTOR [--target SELECTOR ...] (--attr NAME [--attr NAME ...] | --ip-pool CIDR [--ip-pool CIDR ...]))

commands.name: tag-owner add
commands.summary: Add an owner to a tag

commands.name: host set
commands.summary: Set a host alias to an address

commands.name: posture set
commands.summary: Add or replace a posture's expression list

commands.name: posture remove
commands.summary: Remove a posture definition

commands.name: auto-approver add
commands.summary: Add auto-approvers for a route or the exit-node list; idempotent and merges into an existing route
commands.usage: auto-approver add (--route CIDR | --exit-node) --approver SELECTOR [--approver SELECTOR ...] [--comment TEXT]

commands.name: auto-approver remove
commands.summary: Remove auto-approvers; an emptied route key or exitNode member is pruned rather than left as an empty list

commands.name: merge
commands.summary: Compile ACL sources in directories into one policy

commands.name: normalize
commands.summary: Emit the policy as standard JSON for general-purpose JSON tools

commands.name: validate
commands.summary: Validate the policy via the Tailscale API

commands.name: test
commands.summary: Run network tests locally; sshTests are preserved but not evaluated (-strict rejects unparseable rules; --indeterminate controls only test's exit; --watch re-runs on change and never exits non-zero for a verdict; --watch --validate adds explicit credentialed, read-only authoritative server validation)

commands.name: test add
commands.summary: Add deny or accept policy assertions without evaluating them; add never renumbers existing assertion IDs
commands.usage: test add --src SRC (--deny DST:PORT | --accept DST:PORT) [--deny DST:PORT ...] [--accept DST:PORT ...]

commands.name: test remove
commands.summary: Remove deny or accept policy assertions; removing may renumber later assertion IDs
commands.usage: test remove --src SRC (--deny DST:PORT | --accept DST:PORT) [--deny DST:PORT ...] [--accept DST:PORT ...]

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Answer one reachability question locally
commands.usage: check --src SRC (--dst DST:PORT | --dst DST --port PORT) [--proto tcp|udp|sctp|any]

commands.name: lint
commands.summary: Statically lint policy hygiene and broad-rule test coverage (-config currently supports broad-rule-untested allowBroad exclusions)

commands.name: jq
commands.summary: Query the policy with the embedded jq engine

commands.name: pull
commands.summary: Bootstrap a local policy from the live tailnet

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Diff the policy against the live tailnet (read-only)

commands.name: upload
commands.summary: Upload the policy to the tailnet

description: Make typed edits to a Tailscale policy file and query, pull, merge, normalize, validate, test, check, lint, plan, or upload it.

exit_codes.0: success or reachable; server validation warnings with no errors and no message are non-fatal; test also uses 0 for indeterminate assertions under --indeterminate=ignore
exit_codes.1: operation or policy assertion failed, not reachable, or test had an unsettleable assertion under --indeterminate=fail
exit_codes.10: indeterminate: check could not settle the question, test had an unsettleable assertion under --indeterminate=warn, or validate and plan got a response they cannot read as a verdict (warnings with no errors alongside a message, or a detail with neither errors nor warnings)
exit_codes.2: usage, input, or collection error; for pull, validate, and plan this also covers a control plane that never judged the policy (expired credentials, rate limiting, a server fault, an unreadable body, a redirect that dropped the request, or an unreachable API), and no verdict is printed in that case. For test --watch, also signals an unreadable --file, a non-positive --interval, incompatible flag combinations (--indeterminate with --watch, --interval without --watch, --validate without --watch), or a failed write to stdout. For test --watch --validate it additionally covers a missing --tailnet or API/OAuth credentials, which is checked before the loop starts, and a control plane that never judged a snapshot (authentication, authorization, rate_limited, transport, or response), which is reported as one last composite record before the watcher stops. An interrupt during a non-watch command that is mid-request exits here too rather than as a verdict; for upload that means the change may already have been applied. Interrupting either watch mode still exits 0, in-flight validation included

flags.name: file
flags.usage: policy file (typed edits preserve comments in JSON and HuJSON)

flags.name: if-match
flags.usage: upload: explicit ETag overriding the policy-adjacent observed value

flags.name: indeterminate
flags.usage: test only: indeterminate assertion exit policy: fail|warn|ignore (check always exits 10)

flags.name: roster
flags.usage: test/check: PATH to a JSON login-to-role roster, asserting it is complete and authoritative

flags.name: sanitize
flags.usage: output sanitization level: off|identity|strict (a non-off TAILSCALE_SANITIZE value overrides this flag)

flags.name: schema
flags.usage: print the machine-readable tool schema (JSON) and exit

flags.name: strict
flags.usage: test/check: reject a policy containing an unparseable rule instead of warning

lint_findings.description: a selector is undefined or invalid in its policy position
a destination tag has no tagOwners entry, so no node can carry it
a broad all-port grant reaches a concrete destination that no deny assertion names
a grant has an empty required selector list and can never match
a grant is identical to an earlier one
an ipset mixes a remove operation with a member that has no add/remove operation
a tag is defined but referenced by no rule
a group is defined but referenced by no rule
a host alias is defined but referenced by no rule
an ipset is defined but referenced by no rule
a posture is defined but no srcPosture or defaultSrcPosture references it
a svc: service selector used as a rule source; Tailscale services are destination-only
a svc: service selector used as an SSH destination or recorder; those fields require node selectors
a svc: destination names a service not found in the tailnet (requires --online-validation)
a SCIM-shaped group reference has the same name half as a declared local group
a group: reference the control plane reports is not syncing from SCIM (requires --online-validation)

name: tail-acl
sanitization: TAILSCALE_SANITIZE=off|identity|strict sanitizes rendered output after evaluation; a non-off environment value overrides --sanitize. normalize, plan, and jq refuse active sanitization because policy bytes and policy diffs cannot be mechanically sanitized safely. Set TAILSCALE_SANITIZE_KEY (64 hex characters) for operator-scoped placeholders that remain comparable across runs; without it placeholders are artifact-scoped.
